Name: Holy Mackerel (Team Fortress 2 Melee)
Author: radmaninoff
Description:
[center]﻿[i]if you were from where i was from, you'd be $%@!in' [/i][u]fresh[/u][i]![/i][/center]
adds scout teamfortress' [url=https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Holy_Mackerel]holy mackerel [/url]as a club! terribly unbalanced joke weapon with a ton of heart (because the fish hasn't been dressed, you see).

[size=2]FEATURES:[/size]
[list]
[*]semi-[b]original sprite work[/b] (recolors the basegame walleye and adds a newspaper wrapping)
[*][b]fair and balanced[/b] critical hits (serpents now go down in two hits 80% of the time)
[*][b]level 10 fishing[/b] purchase requirement (token nod to any kind of gameplay progression)
[*]sold at [b]willy's [/b](because marlon refused to)! configurable: you can foist this burden upon [b]qi [/b]instead with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿
[*]incredible combat synergy with the golden spur for biblically accurate scout gameplay!
[*]guaranteed [b]fishy fun[/b]!
[/list][size=2]
INSTALLATION:[/size]
[list=1]
[*]install the latest versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]CP[/url]﻿
[*]unzip this mod directly into your Mods folder (or buried under a couple of subfolders, like i do!)
[*]boot up and enjoy!
[/list]
[size=2]COMPAT[/size]
this mod shouldn't conflict with anything, but let me know + [url=https://smapi.io/log]submit a log[/url]﻿ if you run into any issues<3

[size=2]MODS PICTURED:[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]lookup anything[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21286]informant tooltip labels[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17912]vpr-inspired ui[/url]
[/list]
CREDITS:
[list]
[*]scout sfm used in the banner: [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/tf2/comments/p1aw15/sfm_soyjak_scout_png_for_your_use/]DragoDuck[/url]﻿ on reddit
[/list]
